claim_ceiling: Manifold-tower L6 scratch diagnostic only: the metric/relational geometry is restricted to the current survivor set and recomputed after each admissibility constraint. No manifold admission, no bridge, no physics, no formal claim.
description: Finite support S={0,1}^5 with a probe quotient that forgets one hidden bit. The live object is X_t, a subset of quotient classes under the active survivor constraints C_1..C_k. At every step the induced Hamming nearest-neighbor graph G_t is recomputed on X_t itself. A stale control that keeps the initial graph G_0 and only restricts old edges is expected to be wrong once constraints carve away all initial nearest neighbors.

equivalence_relation.name: ~_P
equivalence_relation.definition: s ~_P s_prime iff pi(s) == pi(s_prime), i.e. iff s and s_prime agree on probes p0,p1,p2,p3. The hidden bit is not identity-bearing for this sim.
equivalence_relation.identity_object: vertices are quotient classes [s]_P, represented by their 4-bit probe signatures

induced_geometry.name: InducedGeometry_HammingNN
induced_geometry.metric: d_H(u,v) = Hamming distance between 4-bit probe signatures u and v
induced_geometry.graph_rule: For each survivor set X_t, compute delta_t = min{d_H(u,v): u,v in X_t, u != v}; add an undirected edge u--v iff d_H(u,v) == delta_t. If |X_t| < 2, the graph has no edges.
induced_geometry.recompute_requirement: G_{t+1} is computed from X_{t+1} with a fresh delta_{t+1}; it is not the old G_t relabelled or merely edge-restricted.
induced_geometry.stale_control: Hold G_0 fixed and restrict only its original edges to X_t. This intentionally fails to recompute delta_t and must disagree with the recomputed geometry on the same survivor data.

constraints.role: carves the 4-cube to even-parity quotient vertices; recomputed nearest-neighbor distance changes from 1 to 2
further restricts the even-parity survivor set

state_data_perturbation.purpose: real state/data perturbation of the admissibility predicate. It changes the final survivor set and final induced graph metrics without editing graph labels or expected outputs.

hypotheses_under_test: H_recompute: degree sequence, nearest-neighbor distance, edge count, component count, or diameter of InducedGeometry_HammingNN changes as constraints carve X_t.
H_not_stale: holding the initial graph G_0 stale and merely restricting old edges is detectably wrong on the same survivor set.
H_state_flip: changing the C3 state predicate from first probe == 0 to first probe == 1 flips the final induced graph metrics.
controls_that_must_fire: stale_geometry_control: G_0 restricted to X_1 has zero old distance-1 edges, while recomputed G_1 on even-parity survivors has distance-2 edges and is connected.
state_data_perturbation_control: replacing C3_first_probe_zero by C3_first_probe_one changes the final survivor count and degree sequence.

engines.exact: Python stdlib + numpy-free exact tuple/set reference leg over quotient classes and explicit Hamming distances
engines.jax: JAX x64 boolean-mask leg over the quotient enumeration with a vectorized pairwise Hamming matrix
